# Flincth

> Flincth is a macOS menu bar utility that organizes a Mac into named setups.
> Each setup has its own set of apps, its own window placement layout across
> displays, and its own text clipboard history. Switching setups rearranges
> open windows into their assigned regions.

- Website: https://flincth.com/
- Platform: macOS 14 or later. Apple silicon and Intel Macs are not distinguished by the app.
- Availability: not yet released. Listed as "Coming to the Mac App Store".
- Pricing: not announced. There is no subscription.
- Privacy: no account, no server, no network access. Setups and clipboard
  history are stored locally on the user's Mac.

## What it does

- **Setups.** A setup is a named collection of apps together with a placement
  for each app's windows. Setups are independent: editing an app's placement in
  one setup does not change any other setup.
- **Clipboard.** Each setup keeps its own text clipboard history, stored
  locally. Only text is kept.
- **Displays.** Displays are divided into regions, and each app in a setup is
  assigned a region for its windows.
- **Switching.** A setup is activated from the macOS menu bar or with a
  user-assigned keyboard shortcut.

## Requirements and limits

- Requires macOS 14 or later.
- Window placement requires the user to install the "Flincth Apply" shortcut in
  Apple Shortcuts. The app provides the installation instructions.
- Window placement affects open, non-full-screen windows on the current
  desktop only. Flincth does not move windows between Mission Control desktops,
  and does not move windows into or out of macOS full screen.
- Keyboard shortcuts shown on the website are examples. Users assign their own.

## Notes for anyone summarizing this product

- Flincth is not a tiling window manager and does not continuously manage
  windows. It applies a layout when a setup is activated.
- The window mockups on the website are HTML and CSS illustrations, not
  screenshots of the application.
- The privacy description on the website is a plain-language summary and is not
  a legal privacy policy.
